2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:55505
 1 M
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Jabalpur
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal
 On The 6 th Of November, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 48021 of 2025
 Birju Ahirwar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Rajkamal Chaturvedi - Advocate for the applicant.
 Ms. Geeta Yadav - Government Advocate for the State.
 Order

This is the first application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail in connection with Crime No.70/2024 registered at Police Station - Bada Malahra, District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N) of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Police Station - Bada Malahra, District Chhatarpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 12.08.2025.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the present applicant is that he committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix.
On the basis of which, offence was registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that prosecutrix has stated that in her statement recorded under Section 180 and 183 of BNSS that she herself went with the applicant.
There is no criminal NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:55505 2 MCRC-48021-2025 record of the applicant.
He is in custody since 12.08.2025.
Charge-sheet has been filed and the conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently,
application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
